fields.description:
Objective

Make the Console queue search actually find records. Console search does not support lookup or formula fields — text only.

Implementation Requirements

* Create dedicated Search Key text field(s):

* Sign-Up: Player Name

* Deal / related lists: Deal Name, Partner Name

* Populate via a SINGLE before-save flow covering create and update, no entry criteria needed

* Complete the searchable-field mapping for the Console queue search (search box was enabled 2026-07-22; the field mapping is still outstanding)

Acceptance Criteria

* Searching a player name in the Console returns the Sign-Up

* Search Key values stay current when the source record is renamed

Additional Notes

MERGED from two source items — the Search Key fields and the field mapping are one workstream. Splitting them guarantees one ships without the other.

Estimate: S · \~5h

Source: Wagertech Additional User Stories, July 2026 — items 27 and 36.
